title: Concept: Cargo lockfile resolves a crate from git
description: Cargo.lock declares a locked crate whose source is a git remote, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The code sits outside crates.io checksums and yanks, so the lockfile's integrity model does not describe it.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through Cargo.lock (cargo).
risk: The code sits outside crates.io checksums and yanks, so the lockfile's integrity model does not describe it.
